clue.text: Cared about B&B taking time to provide part of meal?

definitions.note: the question mark flags that this is one example of a dish served at a meal

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of cared are put in a new order

parts.note: B&B is two Bs side by side, as in bed and breakfast
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A guesthouse owner who cares about the bed-and-breakfast trade takes time over what goes on the plate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' shuffles CARED into REDCA; 'taking' simply joins BB to AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A purple-leaved vegetable served as a side dish is an example of one component of a meal.

clue.text: Journey I had guarded by soldiers

indicators.note: something guarded by others is enclosed by them, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the usual crossword soldiers
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a trip made under military escort.
explanation.definitionFit: A trip in a vehicle or on horseback is a short journey.

clue.text: Party rave during which maiden is sleeping

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: during which says the maiden letter arrives in the middle of the rave word

parts.note: to rave is to rant
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A wild party where one girl dozes off through the noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Inactive or at rest, as a volcano or seed is when sleeping.

clue.text: Teach recruit new discipline requiring design skills

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of teach recruit are made into something fresh

explanation.surface: An instructor training a newcomer in a subject that needs a designer's eye.
explanation.definitionFit: The profession of planning buildings is a field of study built on design skill.

clue.text: Irritating person first to board ship

indicators.note: first to picks only the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: a lighter is a flat-bottomed barge used to load ships

explanation.surface: An annoying passenger pushes in to be first aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A colloquial British word for an annoying or contemptible man, a nuisance.

clue.text: Groups providing information over time

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Groups that supply facts over a long period.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology these are classification groups, each above species; the plural of genus.

clue.text: Group lurking nearby!

indicators.note: lurking means hiding inside something, here inside the neighbouring entry

parts.note: nearby points to the entry right beside this one, 1 across, the red cabbage

explanation.surface: A warning that a gang is hiding close at hand.
explanation.walkthrough: The hiding place is not in the clue at all: the letters lurk in the next-door answer at 1 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The Swedish pop quartet famous for Waterloo is a band, a musical group.

clue.text: Someone in vessel has netted fifty fish

indicators.note: netted means caught inside, so the fifty letter goes within the other piece

parts.note: a boater is someone in a boat
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A fisherman in a boat hauls up fifty fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A herring cured by smoking, a type of fish.

clue.text: Disastrous event? Cosy appeal seems out of place

indicators.note: out of place says the letters of cosy appeal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warm, comfortable charm feels wrong at the time of a catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: An end-of-the-world catastrophe is the ultimate disaster.

clue.text: Dreadful things done without leader giving commands

parts.note: dire means dreadful

indicators.note: without leader says the first letter of the word for things done is dropped

parts.note: actions are things done

explanation.surface: Terrible deeds carried out with no one in charge to give orders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without leader' drops A from ACTIONS, leaving CTIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Instructions or orders given to someone are commands.

clue.text: Record animal sound around back of barn

indicators.note: around puts the cow sound on either side of the next piece

parts.note: moo is the sound a cow makes

indicators.note: back of picks the final letter of the word barn

explanation.surface: Recording a cow lowing behind a barn.
explanation.definitionFit: A single-channel recording, the opposite of stereo, is a type of record.

clue.text: With total freedom, Rachel can't be made to change

indicators.note: made to change says the letters of Rachel can't be are rearranged

explanation.surface: Rachel is so stubborn that nobody can make her change her ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase for full discretionary power: unlimited authority to act as one wishes.

clue.text: Formal institution in the country? Quite the opposite

indicators.note: in signals letters found inside the words formal institution
quite the opposite reverses the stated relation: the formal institution is in the country name, not the reverse

explanation.surface: Asking whether a formal institution sits in a country, then saying it is the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, 'Formal institution in the country' would hide the institution in the country; 'Quite the opposite' says the country is in the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A landlocked West African nation is a country.

clue.text: The lady has a table spread, offering drink

parts.note: her refers to the lady

indicators.note: spread out means the letters of a table are scattered and re-laid

explanation.surface: A woman lays out a table and serves a beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' turns A TABLE into BALTEA; 'has' joins it to HER.
explanation.definitionFit: An infusion of herbs in hot water is a drink.

clue.text: Available to anyone coming along being outgoing?

definitions.meaning: describing seats not booked in advance, open to whoever arrives
frank and open in manner, not holding back

explanation.definitionFit: Unbooked seats are free to any comer, and a frank, open person holds nothing back.

clue.text: Entertained by one loveless leftie, a dry person gossiped

indicators.note: entertained by means held within, so the dry person goes inside
love is zero in tennis, the letter O, so loveless removes an O

parts.note: one taken as written
TT means teetotal, a person who does not drink
a red is a left-winger

explanation.surface: A sober guest chatting with a lonely socialist host.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loveless' uses tennis, where love is nil: the letter O goes. 'Entertained by' puts the dry person, a teetotaller, inside the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Chattered idly at length, so talked gossip.

clue.text: It's doubly right to remain outside — when the night is this?

indicators.note: outside says the remain word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: to stay is to remain

indicators.note: doubly means the right letter appears twice

explanation.surface: Advice to stay outdoors on a clear night.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface urges staying outside, the wordplay places STAY outside RR.
explanation.definitionFit: A clear night sky full of visible stars is studded with them.

clue.text: Someone at conference given instruction to remove all attendees?

parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark meaning delete
the gate is the total number of spectators at an event

explanation.surface: A conference delegate is told to throw everyone out.
explanation.definitionFit: A representative sent to attend a conference.

clue.text: The oil loosened old tool

indicators.note: loosened says the letters of the oil are freed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Oil has freed up a rusty old implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A crude chipped flint thought to be among the earliest human implements.

clue.text: The Parisian, a figure in mathematics, is saying few words

parts.note: la is French for the, feminine
a conic is a curve such as an ellipse or parabola

explanation.surface: A French mathematician says very little.
explanation.definitionFit: Terse and brief in speech, using few words.

clue.text: Fixed supports creating difficulties

parts.note: set means fixed
to back is to support

explanation.surface: Rigid backing causes problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverses or hitches in progress are difficulties.

clue.text: Criminal trick has six coming to court

parts.note: a con is a trick
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A con man and his six associates are brought before a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: A person found guilty of a crime and imprisoned is a criminal.

clue.text: Female very aggressive and very old holding one charitable event

indicators.note: holding says the first pair of letters wraps round the rest

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a rag is a British student fund-raising event for charity

explanation.surface: A fierce, elderly woman running a charity day.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'very' belongs to the definition; the second gives V. A rag is a British university students' charity week.
explanation.definitionFit: A domineering, bad-tempered woman, a shrew or harridan.

clue.text: Joining former scoundrels, this person has to be going off-topic

parts.note: ex means former
curs are contemptible men, scoundrels
the setter speaking, this person has is I've

explanation.surface: The setter admits to wandering off the subject by joining a band of ex-villains.
explanation.definitionFit: Digressive, rambling away from the main subject.

clue.text: Spots some men carelessly falling over

indicators.note: falling over means those letters are read backwards
some means only part of the letters of men carelessly are used

explanation.surface: Men tripping clumsily and getting spots.
explanation.walkthrough: The run ENCA sits in 'men carelessly'; 'falling over' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin condition marked by pimples, so spots.

clue.text: Number in favour of storing radioactive element

indicators.note: storing means holding inside, so the element goes within

parts.note: for means in favour of
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: Many people support storing nuclear material.
explanation.definitionFit: A small whole number, one more than three.

clue.text: Plant that's heavenly Di plucked

indicators.note: plucked means pulled out, so those two letters are removed

parts.note: divine means heavenly
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gorgeous plant that Di picked.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing plant, especially the grape-bearing kind.

clue.text: Drink to spoil material when getting absorbed

indicators.note: getting absorbed says the when word is soaked up inside the rest

parts.note: to mar is to spoil
chino is a cotton twill fabric
as can mean when

explanation.surface: Spilling a drink ruins fabric as it soaks in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherry liqueur, so a drink.

clue.text: In America pack a platform

definitions.meaning: in American usage a pack of cards
a floor or flat surface such as a ship's or a terrace

explanation.definitionFit: Americans say this for a pack of cards, and it is also a flat raised surface.

clue.text: Affectionate communication, nothing to be presented to landlord?

parts.note: love means zero in tennis scores
a letter is one who lets property

explanation.surface: A tender message, with nothing given to the owner of the property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' here is someone who lets property, a landlord.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic note sent to someone one adores.
